transaction.description: One unsigned Base transaction; credentials, signatures, signed transactions, custody, signing, and broadcast grants are refused.

policy.description: The exact deterministic policy clauses to evaluate.

anchor.description: One immutable Base block number and hash.

evidence.description: Deterministic evidence objects cited by policy clauses.

framings.title: Trashpanda Base Pre-Sign Policy Conformance
framings.description: Deterministically evaluates one unsigned Base transaction against the buyer's exact policy and immutable block anchor before signing, returning a replayable clause-by-clause PASS, FAIL, or ESCALATE receipt. No keys, signatures, custody, signing, or broadcast authority are accepted.

candidate.description: One proposed BUY, SELL, CLOSE, REDUCE, or HOLD action; never an order or execution grant.

anchor.description: One immutable content-addressed snapshot and bounded decision-validity window.

evidence.description: Sorted customer-declared, publicly referenceable observations bound to the snapshot.

policy.description: Sorted deterministic admission clauses for venue, instrument, action, notional, leverage, evidence thresholds, and freshness.

framings.title: Trashpanda Market Action Admission
framings.description: Deterministically evaluates one proposed market action against the buyer's exact policy, immutable snapshot, fees, risk limits, and customer-declared public evidence, returning a replayable ADMIT, REFUSE, or ESCALATE receipt. It does not predict markets, handle keys, hold custody, sign, place orders, or execute trades.
